title: Search a module context.md for its Lessons heading at any size in chough next, and remove next's named 4 MiB exception from REQ-cli-034 while library snapshot's exception stays
description: Search a module context.md for its Lessons heading at any size in chough next, and remove next's named 4 MiB exception from REQ-cli-034 while library snapshot's exception stays
acceptance_criteria: `chough next` reports the 1-based line of `## Lessons` in a module context.md larger than 4 MiB, CRLF included, and `no Lessons section` for one without it, never a size note
tests/next.rs::next_searches_a_context_md_larger_than_4_mib fails before the fix and passes after it, and the existing lessons pointer test still passes

answers.constraints: REQ-cli-034, accepted and archived in change read-native-specsync-spec-files-under-specs-at-any-size-chough-s-65536-byte-structured-record-bound-no-longer-applies on this pull request, names chough next's 4 MiB context.md search as a known exception; this change modifies REQ-cli-034 to remove that exception and keeps chough library snapshot's 4 MiB refusal as a named exception. Every Chough record keeps its bound under REQ-cli-032. AGENTS.md: never invent results.
